resources.string: This configuration does not verify the server certificate and is less secure.
You have no configuration yet. Use the Add button to import the link, file or QR code you got from your service provider.
Add or select a configuration first.
Place the configuration QR code inside the frame
No valid configuration found. Make sure you copied the whole link or file.
Could not add. Please try again.
The file could not be read or is larger than 8 MB.
Another app sent you a configuration. Only add it if you trust the sender.
The list of configurations will be downloaded from \"%1$s\". Only continue if you trust this address.
This protocol is not supported on this device yet. Please choose another configuration.
VPN permission was not granted. Tap \"Try again\" and choose OK in the Android dialog.
Could not connect. Check the configuration and your internet connection, then try again.
The internet does not work through this connection. The server may be down or its address wrong; try another configuration.
This configuration cannot be used. Delete it or get a fresh one from your service provider.
The app storage could not be opened. Please reopen the app.
The VPN connection was ended by the system or another app. Tap \"Try again\" to reconnect.
This section is for advanced users. You do not need to change anything for normal use.
Leave empty for the default (DNS over HTTPS). You can enter an IP, https://… or tls://…
To keep traffic from leaking when the VPN drops, enable \"Always-on VPN\" and \"Block connections without VPN\" for this app in Android\'s VPN settings.
Technical details of the last error
When off, \"Connected\" is shown as soon as the tunnel starts. Turn it off for configurations that only route a private network.
A report without configuration names, server addresses or passwords that you can send to support. Nothing is sent automatically.
Read the text before sending it. Only you decide whether to share it.
Retrying automatically. Tap the button to stop.
Traffic is not passing through the VPN (your public address is the same with and without it). The connection was closed; try another configuration.

If it keeps failing: 1) Try your internet without the VPN. 2) Choose another configuration or get a fresh one from your provider. 3) Turn off other VPN apps. 4) Run the connection test in Advanced settings.
Only some names (DNS) were resolved through the VPN; some sites may not open.
Only some of the test sites opened through the VPN.
UDP (some games and calls) does not pass through this server; the web and normal apps should work.
Your public address is the same with and without the VPN.
The internet check is off; the connection is not verified.
Checks that traffic really goes through the VPN: DNS, Google and Cloudflare sites, UDP, IPv6 and the egress address. Works only while connected.
Connect to the VPN first, then run the test.
Only some names resolved. Check the server\'s DNS or the network, or set another DNS in Advanced settings.
Names do not resolve. Usually the server is down; try another configuration.
Did not open. If both sites fail, the server or configuration is the problem.
UDP does not work. The web should work; games and video calls need another server.
IPv6 is not available. This normally causes no problem.
Same address with and without the VPN (the server is on your own network). If it is not, traffic is not passing through the tunnel.
Traffic is not passing through the VPN. Try another configuration.
Could not compare (the direct network was unavailable or blocked).
Choose this app\'s language in Android settings.
